articles.headline: McCarthy gets game ball from Rodgers after Steelers' win

articles.headline: Josh Allen, Bills use big plays to score big win vs. Texans
articles.description: In a house of Bills horrors -- they hadn't won in Houston since '06 -- vs. a team that battered him last season, Josh Allen uncorked a whopper of an offensive performance as Buffalo outlasted Houston 36-31, giving Joe Brady his first victory as coach.
